svg.title: Aria system architecture
svg.desc: A source-accurate architecture diagram of Aria's user surfaces, FastAPI and WhatsApp ingress, orchestrator, runtime, configured language model provider, memory, tools, skills, configuration, persistence, operations, and message-to-response flow.
svg.text: Current application components and the paths that connect them

g.text: The active provider depends on config.
WhatsApp gateway and tool sandbox use profiles.
SQLite graph DB is also stored under local state.

svg.text: Aria has no order-placement workflow; this shows its real assistant request flow.
Diagram labels reflect repository components. Optional services are marked; model selection is configuration-dependent.
